description: List every tool of Private AI Tools, or the tools of one category, with their page URL. The tools run in the user's web browser: give the user the link. Files are never sent to this server or to the assistant.

category.description: Only this category: image (Image & design), video (Video), audio (Audio & music), pdf (PDF), business (Business & writing), developer (Developer tools), data (Data, maps & science), calculators (Calculators & timers), whiteboards (Whiteboards & diagrams), games (Games & learning), 3d (3D printing, CAD & electronics), crafts (Crafts & laser), codes (QR codes, barcodes & fonts), device (Device tests)

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and pages: en, it, es, fr, de (default en). Use the user's language; English words are understood in every language.

name: list_tools
title: List the tools
